## Type of Change

- [ ] 🚀 **Feature** — New functionality (non-breaking change)
- [ ] 🐛 **Bug Fix** — Fixes an issue (non-breaking change)
- [ ] 🔧 **Refactor** — Code improvement without functional change
- [ ] 📝 **Documentation** — Documentation-only changes
- [ ] 🎨 **Style** — Code formatting, styling (no logic change)
- [ ] ⚡ **Performance** — Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧪 **Tests** — Adding or updating tests
- [ ] 🔒 **Security** — Security fix or improvement
- [ ] 🛠️ **Chore** — Build, CI, tooling, dependency updates

## ✅ Checklist

### Code Quality

- [ ] My code follows the project's code style
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented complex logic where necessary
- [ ] No debugging code, console.log, or commented-out code remains
- [ ] No TODOs or FIXMEs introduced
- [ ] Error handling is implemented appropriately

### Testing

- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix/feature works
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] Test coverage is maintained or improved
- [ ] Edge cases have been considered and tested

### Documentation

- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation
- [ ] API changes include OpenAPI/Swagger annotations
- [ ] README or other guides are updated if needed
- [ ] Changes are noted in the changelog (if applicable)

### Security & Breaking Changes

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or tokens are included in the code
- [ ] Input validation is present on all user-facing endpoints
- [ ] Auth/permission checks are in place on protected endpoints
